messages.author: 33ffbd5d5e9bca08
messages.subject: how to check cpp file?
parts:
Dear all,

I am a TMB beginner. I recently wrote one cpp file and run it in r, but r aborted and gave me issues as "TMB has received an error from Eigen. The following condition was not met: index >=0 && index<size(), Please check your matrix-vector bounds etc., or run your program through a debugger.". I have no idea why r collapses, would you mind checking my codes attached? Thanks.

messages.author: 90b303eef43fd993
messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] how to check cpp file?
parts:
There is more information on out-of-bounds errors here:


http://kaskr.github.io/adcomp/_book/Errors.html#compilation-errors


A guide on how to set up the debugger on a Windows system is here:


https://github.com/kaskr/adcomp/wiki/Windows-installation#windows-debugging
